summary: Sandbach United kicked off their 2026/27 season in style with a 3-1 victory over league newcomers Wednesfield CFC, with Bevan grabbing two goals to lead the charge. The team showed great chemistry early on with five new players in the starting lineup, dominating possession throughout despite a fortunate equalizer from the visitors. The Ramblers made several substitutions to manage the game and secured a winning start to the campaign at home.
